**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Attach the polynomial procedure to the approved second part**

For `qrow_9709_s19_qp_33_q06::q06/ii`, the preceding logic creates an approved `apply_polynomial_factor_remainder` classification, whose QuestionType is globally wired to the polynomial ProcedureModel, but this special case suppresses its ProcedureInstance. Consequently, product readback returns an approved procedure model and steps while reporting `composition_status: "not_applicable"` with no instances; it is also the only approved Algebra binding with this inconsistency. Either emit the corresponding core instance or avoid approving the modeled classification for this part.

+def load_predecessor_builder(repo: Path) -> Any:
+    path = repo / PREDECESSOR_BUILDER_RELATIVE
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("issue_1727_predecessor", path)
+    require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "predecessor builder unavailable")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module

+def authenticated_predecessor(repo: Path, release_cache: dict[int, tuple[Any, ...]] | None = None) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+    release_cache = {} if release_cache is None else release_cache
+    predecessor = load_predecessor_builder(repo)
+    generated = release_cache.get(PREDECESSOR_ISSUE)
+    if generated is None:
+        generated = predecessor.build_release(repo, release_cache)
+    chain_validator = predecessor.authenticated_predecessor(repo, release_cache)[0]
+    require(generated[2]["issue"] == PREDECESSOR_ISSUE, "generated predecessor issue drift")
+    require(
+        chain_validator.sha256_bytes(chain_validator.canonical_bytes(generated[2]))
+        == PREDECESSOR_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        "predecessor manifest authentication failed",
+    )
+    return (chain_validator, *generated[:6])

+def canonical_source_question_key(question_key: str) -> str:
+    return f"qrow_{question_key.removeprefix(WATERMARK_QUESTION_PREFIX)}" if question_key.startswith(WATERMARK_QUESTION_PREFIX) else question_key

+def discover_scope(helper: Any, repo: Path, nodes_document: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str], dict[str, tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]]]:
+    source_map = helper.read_json(repo / SOURCE_MAP_RELATIVE)
+    plain_text = helper.read_json(repo / PLAIN_TEXT_RELATIVE)
+    verified = {node["node_id"] for node in nodes_document["nodes"] if node["node_type"] == "Question"}
+    discoverable = sorted(
+        ({**row, "question_key": canonical_source_question_key(row["question_key"]), "question_row_id": canonical_source_question_key(row["question_row_id"])}
+         for row in source_map["rows"] if row.get("primary_topic_path") == "9709.p3.algebra"),
+        key=lambda row: row["question_key"],
+    )
+    require(len(discoverable) == EXPECTED_DISCOVERABLE_ROWS, "discoverable Algebra scope drift")
+    require(len({row["question_key"] for row in discoverable}) == len(discoverable), "normalized Algebra source keys collide")
+    selected = [row for row in discoverable if row["question_key"] in verified]
+    excluded = [row["question_key"] for row in discoverable if row["question_key"] not in verified]
+    require(len(selected) == EXPECTED_VERIFIED_QUESTIONS and len(excluded) == EXPECTED_EXCLUDED_UNVERIFIED_ROWS, "verified Algebra scope conservation failed")
+    text_by_storage = {
+        item["storage_key"]: (index, item) for index, item in enumerate(plain_text["items"])
+        if isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("storage_key"), str)
+    }
+    require(all(row["storage_key"] in text_by_storage for row in selected), "Algebra source-text join is incomplete")
+    return selected, excluded, text_by_storage

+def review_bucket(question_id: str, owner_path: str, ordered_paths: list[str]) -> str:
+    position = ordered_paths.index(owner_path)
+    if question_id in ABS_QUESTIONS:
+        return "graph" if len(ordered_paths) > 1 and position == 0 else "modulus"
+    if question_id in PARTIAL_QUESTIONS:
+        if position == 0:
+            return "partial"
+        return "validity" if len(ordered_paths) > 2 and position == len(ordered_paths) - 1 else "series"
+    if question_id in BINOMIAL_QUESTIONS:
+        return "validity" if len(ordered_paths) > 1 and position == len(ordered_paths) - 1 else "binomial"
+    return "polynomial"

+    selected, excluded, text_by_storage = discover_scope(helper, repo, base_nodes)
+    _, support = helper.graph_indexes(base_nodes, base_edges)
+    selected_ids = {row["question_key"] for row in selected}
+    require(ALL_REVIEWED_QUESTIONS == selected_ids, "explicit Algebra review set does not conserve verified scope")
+    score_parts: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for node in base_nodes["nodes"]:
+        if node["node_type"] == "QuestionPart" and node.get("role") == "score_owning" and node.get("question_id") in selected_ids:
+            score_parts[node["question_id"]].append(node)
+    require(sum(map(len, score_parts.values())) == EXPECTED_SCORE_OWNING_PARTS, "score-owning Algebra part count drift")
+
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    instances: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    alternatives = {

+        ("qrow_9709_s22_qp_33_q01", "q01/$whole"),
+    }
+    for row in selected:
+        question_id = row["question_key"]
+        actual_parts = sorted(score_parts[question_id], key=lambda part: part["owner_path"])
+        paths = [part["owner_path"] for part in actual_parts]
+        text_index, text_item = text_by_storage[row["storage_key"]]
+        text = str(text_item.get("normalized_plain_text") or "").strip()
+        require(text, f"reviewed source text missing: {question_id}")
+        bindings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        decision_refs: list[str] = []
+        instance_refs: list[str] = []
+        for part in actual_parts:
+            owner_path = part["owner_path"]
+            part_id = part["node_id"]
+            bucket = review_bucket(question_id, owner_path, paths)
+            evidence = helper.exact_part_evidence(part_id, support)
+            decision_ref = f"algebra-part-review::{question_id}::{owner_path}"
+            is_numerical_candidate = question_id == NUMERICAL_QUESTION and owner_path.endswith("/iii")
+            type_id = None if is_numerical_candidate else BUCKET_TYPE[bucket]
+            decision = {

+                "disposition": "candidate_foreign_family_support" if is_numerical_candidate else "approved_primary",
+                "exact_part_evidence_refs": evidence,

+                        "procedure_model_ref": None,

+                    } if is_numerical_candidate else None
+                ),
+                "primary_question_type_ref": type_id,
+                "secondary_question_type_refs": [],
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "question_part_id": part_id,
+                "review_basis": "manual_exact_question_part_qp_ms_review",
+                "review_status": "reviewed_terminal",
